examples.name: Noise-area intraday momentum (Zarattini 2024)
examples.asked: Buy when price breaks above the 14-day noise band around the open, sell below; trail at VWAP; flat at the close.
rules: Band per minute = avg |move from 09:30 open| of the last 14 days
Long above upper band, short below lower band
examples.headline: USTEC +19.6 %/yr, Sharpe 1.41; after publication +15.7 %/yr, Sharpe 1.02
examples.why: Works on the Nasdaq-100 in every year; weaker on US500, absent on US30.

examples.name: AMD / Power of 3
examples.asked: Asian range, London sweeps one side and closes back inside, trade the other way into New York.
rules: Sweep + M5 close back inside 02:00-05:00 NY
Enter opposite, stop beyond the sweep
Target opposite side or 2R, out by 12:00 NY
examples.headline: ~7,000 FX + gold trades: -0.03 R; best pick (gold) reversed to -0.08 R
examples.why: The London sweep is a coin flip.

examples.name: MACD + 200 EMA
examples.asked: Buy a MACD cross below zero above the 200 EMA, target 1.5x risk.
examples.headline: About 0 R everywhere; 9/10 best picks failed the check
examples.why: Indicator rules on price alone keep landing at zero.

examples.name: Friday lower high -> Monday visits Friday's low
examples.asked: If Friday's high stays below Thursday's, Friday's low is visited on Monday.
rules: Visit = Monday regular session trades below Friday's low
Trade: short at the open to Friday's low, 1:1 stop
examples.headline: Visited 41 % vs 31 % otherwise; the short loses -0.07 R
examples.why: Monday simply opens closer to the low; at equal distance the odds are the same.

examples.name: Overnight range thirds + ADX
examples.asked: Open in the top/bottom third of the overnight range, trade the break with ADX > 20.
rules: Open in top third -> long setup, bottom third -> short
M5 close beyond the range, ADX > 20
examples.headline: +0.10 R, t 1.41 - not significant
examples.why: ADX adds nothing; the thirds add a little.

examples.name: Fade the crypto crowd
examples.asked: When most Binance accounts are unusually long, short for 3 days (and the reverse).
rules: All-account long/short ratio z >= 1.5 vs 90 days
examples.headline: +69 bps per trade, positive all 3 years, p 0.045
